title: ECP Registration Amendment (M3-RG0 — new version/event, never a rewrite)
description: An amendment event against an accepted trust-registration record (M3-RG0, 0.7.0, order §5). Amendments NEVER mutate the original record: the original file stays byte-identical and its commitments remain verifiable; the amendment is a new append-only document plus a lineage amendment-recorded event. Case content and ground truth are NOT amendable — the only correction path for those is explicit invalidation. Permissible amendment kinds: environment-revision (new environment commitment), provenance-correction (new provenance commitment), invalidation (explicit, motivated retirement of the registration). target_registration_hash binds the amendment to the EXACT original version it amends. amendment_hash = SHA-256 over the ECP-CANONICAL-JSON-1.0 serialization with amendment_hash removed. Real amendment material lives only in a private trust area; public illustrations under examples/ must be format-illustration records with real recomputable hashes.

content_class.description: 'review' = real amendment material (private trust area only); 'format-illustration' = public dummy (examples/ only).

amendment_id.description: Deterministic identity assigned by the Registration Authority (monotone).

target_registration_hash.description: SHA-256 over the FULL target record (including its populated registration_hash) — binds this amendment to one exact original version.

motivation.description: Explicit, non-empty motivation — silent corrections are forbidden.

environment.description: The revised environment document (new environment commitment recomputed by the authority).

provenance.description: The corrected provenance document (new provenance commitment recomputed by the authority).

replacement.description: New-version content for the amended field. Case content and ground truth are never replaceable here (invalidation is the only path).

new_commitments.description: Commitments recomputed by the authority over the replacement documents (recorded in the amendment event for verification).

event_index.description: Index of the amendment-recorded lineage event (the event carries this amendment's amendment_hash).
